name: Moneyball 2.0
primary_population: male players with exact CM token among FIFA player_positions

entity_match.rule: unique normalized exact alias AND exact date of birth; reciprocal one-to-one; quarantine height difference >10cm

similarity_preprocessing.numeric: StandardScaler fit on training CM only; persist scaler
similarity_preprocessing.group_weighting: multiply each standardized attribute by sqrt(1 / (7 * number_of_attributes_in_its_group))
similarity_preprocessing.ranking: cosine similarity of weighted standardized vectors
similarity_preprocessing.missing_core: exclude from v1; never impute using future observations

derivations.work_rate_attack: first component of FIFA work_rate split by /
derivations.work_rate_defence: second component of FIFA work_rate split by /

valuation_preprocessing.missing_league_id: UNKNOWN category; league_id is categorical, not a continuous player identifier
valuation_preprocessing.categorical: one-hot encoding with unknown-category handling, fit on training fold
valuation_preprocessing.numeric: fit imputer and any scaling on training fold only
valuation_preprocessing.feature_selection: explicit allowlist only; never use all columns except target

target.definition: log1p of positive TM market value with latest date <= cutoff
target.currency: source units; supplied TM CSV has no currency column; EUR denomination is not independently certified by this audit
target.zero: exclude from valuation target; do not interpret as a zero-cost transfer
target.interpretation: cross-sectional recorded market valuation, not transfer fee or future performance

evaluation_contract.single_snapshot: group holdout by player identity; preprocessing fit inside training folds; compare to training-median valuation baseline
evaluation_contract.historical_panel: chronological train/validation/test; purge future snapshots and duplicate player observations across partitions for a cold-start test
evaluation_contract.similarity: same CM, age and budget filters for method and overall baseline; internal similarity is descriptive
evaluation_contract.claims: market-value residual is a screening signal, not evidence of real-world underpricing or sporting success
